basic_details.short_information: Delhi Technological University (DTU) has released the DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 notification for 219 vacancies across 24 disciplines, including backlog vacancies and a special PwBD recruitment drive. Online applications open on 23 October 2026 at 11:00 AM and close on 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The recruitment has no upper age limit for Assistant Professor appointments.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 - Discipline-wise Details
content_sections.text: DTU has notified 219 Assistant Professor vacancies across Engineering, Applied Sciences, Management, Humanities, Design and other disciplines. Computer Science and Engineering has the highest number of vacancies with 36 posts, followed by Civil Engineering and Production Engineering with 20 posts each. Computer Science and Engineering has 36 vacancies, including 7 UR, 1 SC, 6 ST, 16 OBC and 6 EWS posts. Three positions are identified for PwBD reservation within the notified total. Mechanical Engineering has 18 vacancies, comprising 2 UR, 4 SC, 1 ST, 9 OBC and 2 EWS posts. Two PwBD positions are identified within these vacancies. Civil Engineering has 20 vacancies, including 7 UR, 2 SC, 2 ST, 6 OBC and 3 EWS posts, with two identified PwBD positions.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Notification 2026 PDF Download
DTU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 depends on the discipline. Candidates must possess the degrees, relevant specializations and experience, where prescribed, under the university's applicable recruitment rules. DTU provides links to the detailed recruitment rules covering qualifications, pay scale, relevant branches and experience. Applicants should check the recruitment rules for their chosen discipline before applying. Meeting the minimum qualification alone does not guarantee shortlisting for presentation or interview. Applicants for Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics and other engineering disciplines must meet the prescribed undergraduate, postgraduate or other approved qualification combinations for the relevant branch. Applicants for Applied Chemistry, Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, Humanities, Economics and related subjects must satisfy the qualifications and academic conditions under their respective DTU recruitment rules. The detailed notification also specifies applicable UGC-related relaxation provisions for certain disciplines.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be assessed as on 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should consult the relevant recruitment rules before relying on a salary figure. DTU's published Assistant Professor recruitment rules include Level 10 with entry pay of ₹57,700 for certain disciplines, but the applicable pay terms should be checked for the selected vacancy.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 application fee is ₹2,000 for UR and OBC candidates, ₹1,000 for eligible EWS, SC and ST candidates, and nil for PwBD candidates. The reduced fee is available only where the applicant applies against an appropriately reserved vacancy and meets the applicable conditions. Payment Mode: Online only. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred or adjusted against another recruitment process. Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 selection process includes initial academic screening, detailed scrutiny, document and point-mark verification, teaching presentation and interview. The final assessment considers academic record, teaching or research experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance. Initial application screening based on the notified 100-point criteria. Publication of the provisional consideration-zone list. Submission and scrutiny of supporting documents by candidates in the consideration zone. Provisional shortlisting according to eligibility and screening scores. Document and Point Mark Verification. Teaching Aptitude and Ability Presentation. Domain Knowledge Assessment and Interview. DTU will use a 100-point initial screening system. The score is based on Ph.D. qualification, the prescribed pre-Ph.D. degree and qualifying national-level tests or scholarships. The pre-Ph.D. degree score is calculated according to the notification's formula: 35 + 0.5 × (X − 50), where X is the percentage obtained in the eligible pre-Ph.D. degree. The calculation is subject to the prescribed maximum score and recruitment rules. The online application also requires academic and research credentials under a separate 50-point framework. This is distinct from the 100-point initial screening criteria. The academic section considers undergraduate marks, postgraduate marks, Ph.D. qualification and relevant qualifying examinations. The experience and research section considers eligible teaching, research and industrial experience, publications, books, projects, patents and research guidance.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor PwBD Special Recruitment Drive 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor notification includes a special recruitment drive identifying 17 PwBD-designated positions within the total 219 vacancies. These are horizontal reservation positions, not 17 additional vacancies. PwBD applicants should consult the discipline-wise suitability details in Annexure-I and the relevant reservation provisions before applying.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: DTU will provide reservation benefits according to the applicable Government of NCT of Delhi instructions. Candidates applying under a reserved category must possess the required certificate by the closing date of 7 December 2026. EWS candidates must meet the prescribed income and asset certification requirements. Eligible SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwBD candidates should check the relevant certificate formats, issue dates and category conditions.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 online application process opens on 23 October 2026 at 11:00 AM and closes on 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Eligible candidates must complete the online application through the official DTU website. Separate applications and fees are required for different disciplines. DTU Assistant Professor Apply Online 2026: Visit Official DTU Recruitment Website Important: DTU does not permit changes or corrections, including category changes, after final submission. Multiple applications against the same post may lead to rejection. Applicants applying in different disciplines must submit separate forms. Not every applicant is required to send a hard copy immediately after the online application. Candidates included in the university's notified consideration zone must submit a printed and signed application with self-attested supporting documents within the separately announced deadline. Hard Copy Submission Address for Notified Candidates: The Recruitment Cell, Room No. 818, 8th Floor, AB-3 Block, Delhi Technological University, Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, Delhi - 110042. The envelope must clearly mention the Assistant Professor post and the discipline applied for, as instructed in the notification. Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Ph.D. degree certificate, where applicable Relevant NET, GATE, GPAT, CEED or other qualifying-test records, where applicable Teaching, research and industrial experience certificates Research publications and supporting publication records Research project sanction or completion documents, where applicable Patent and research guidance records, where applicable Relevant category or PwBD certificate Equivalence certificate for applicable foreign qualifications Recent colour photograph and signature Submitted application form and fee payment receipt Applicants included in the consideration zone must provide supporting documents for claimed screening and academic points. Original documents will be required at the prescribed verification stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DTU has announced 219 Assistant Professor vacancies across 24 disciplines, including backlog vacancies and 17 PwBD-designated positions within the total.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application deadline is 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no upper age limit for appointment to Assistant Professor posts under the detailed Advertisement No. 04/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the DTU Assistant Professor application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹2,000 for UR/OBC candidates, ₹1,000 for eligible EWS/SC/ST reserved-category applicants and nil for PwBD candidates. Fee concessions are subject to the notification conditions.

faq.question: Q5. How many DTU Assistant Professor Computer Science vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 36 Computer Science and Engineering Assistant Professor vacancies, including 7 UR, 1 SC, 6 ST, 16 OBC and 6 EWS positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the DTU Assistant Professor salary per month?
faq.answer: Salary depends on the applicable discipline-specific pay rules. Published DTU Assistant Professor rules include Level 10 entry pay of ₹57,700 for certain disciplines, but candidates must check the recruitment rule applicable to their post. The advertisement does not give a fixed in-hand amount.

faq.question: Q7. Is a Ph.D. mandatory for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Ph.D. eligibility depends on the relevant discipline-specific recruitment rules. The screening system awards points for a Ph.D., but this does not itself establish that every advertised post has an identical Ph.D. requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written exam for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The detailed advertisement does not specify a common written examination. It describes academic screening, document and point verification, teaching presentation and interview.

faq.question: Q9. How does DTU shortlist Assistant Professor applicants?
faq.answer: DTU initially screens applications using a 100-point system covering Ph.D., prescribed pre-Ph.D. qualifications and qualifying tests. Eligible candidates proceed through the notified consideration-zone and document-verification stages.

faq.question: Q10. Does DTU count guest faculty experience?
faq.answer: Guest faculty experience is not counted in the notified experience scoring criteria. Eligible regular or contractual teaching experience is assessed according to the advertisement's conditions.
